title: Wolf Menace
description: Three parties this month have come into the guild hall off the Millbrook road with wolf bites and torn packs. Not dire wolves - just a pack that has learned where travelers walk.

objectives.description: Thin the pack on the Millbrook road

notes: Threat: repeated wolf attacks on travelers along the Millbrook road, small but accumulating. Giver motive: the guild's real hunters are on paying contracts, so a standing bounty absorbs the complaints instead. Refusal: the complaints and bites keep coming in.
